text.en: Reviewers emphasize owner Vlada's deep passion for animals, noting that she treats every customer's dog or cat like her own. Long-time patrons—some visiting for over 17 years—praise her warm customer care, willingness to accept last-minute weekend requests, and prompt phone calls as soon as grooming finishes.

title.en: Flawless breed cuts and cat grooming

text.en: Clients consistently celebrate high-caliber haircuts, specifically admiring elegant lion cuts on cats, stylish Yorkie styling, and hygienic trims on cavachons. Pet parents report that coats look clean and even, smelling fresh for days, with charming finishing touches such as painted nails and decorative clips.

title.en: Patient handling for anxious and sensitive pets

text.en: Owners highlight how patiently Vlada handles nervous dogs, fearful rescue animals, and large German Shepherds without stress. Reviews note that pets with sensitive skin or allergies experience zero adverse reactions, remaining cheerful and happy throughout efficient sessions that usually finish in under two hours.

q.en: Can they accommodate fearful or difficult-to-groom dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that Vlada comfortably accepts dogs turned away by other salons, handling them with patient and gentle care.

q.en: Does the salon offer cat grooming services?

a.en: Yes, clients praise Vlada for performing stress-free cat grooming, including neat lion cuts and gentle deshedding baths.

q.en: How quickly are grooming sessions completed?

a.en: Reviewers report that sessions are typically finished in under two to three hours, preventing pets from waiting all day in crates.
